_readme: Outside websites for the Tools page (/coc/tools/, 'Outside websites'), shown in this order. coc-guides.js builds each as a grey .tc-card: the favicon, name (the title), the domain beside it (read from url), and desc -- one plain line on what the site is. Clicking one opens the 'You're leaving Parchrome' dialog first. icon: a local 128px favicon in clashofclans/coctools/favicons/.
